Personal data should not be entered into GenAI systems that are not supported/approved by the University.
No personal data should be collected, stored or uploaded to a GenAI system, without permission/consent, including images or photographs

safeguards.quote: Personal data should be used in line with the University’s data protection policies and data protection notices (student and staff).
Where specific prompts or other initial/seed inputs are used, these should be used in line with the University’s Artificial Intelligence Information Security Policy (when commenced).

Students should familiarise themselves with the capabilities and limitations of any Generative AI tool or system they propose to use, including changes that may emerge as part of a review of new product iterations, particularly those that may impact data privacy and copyright.
